Italiano Photo Video Maker — Version 1.0.0

- Cloud GPU processing delivers shareable MP4 files within 30–60 seconds.
- Handles uploads, exports, credits, and project edits in a single streamlined workflow.
- Designed for Italian content creators seeking quick video generation from photo collections.
